title: Integration by Parts Formulas of Mckean-Vlasov SDEs with Jumps and Some Applications
summary: In this article, we establish integration by parts formulas for the solutions of McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equations with jumps under elliptic coefficients. The derived formulas accommodate both derivatives with respect to real-valued variables and measure-valued variables, interpreted through the Lions' derivative.
